title: Use simple directive paths.

title: The … identification '…:' is redundant and can be removed.
summary: Try removing the redundant … identification. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 3.11.

title: 'Array's must have an 'Array' annotation that matches the dimensions.

title: Use a 'SizedBox' to add whitespace to a layout.
summary: Try using a 'SizedBox' rather than a 'Container'. Its category is flutter, style. It is stable since Dart 2.9.
message_templates: Use a 'SizedBox' to add whitespace to a layout.

title: Use 'SizedBox.…' to avoid needing to specify the 'height' and 'width'.
summary: Try using 'SizedBox.…' and removing the 'height' and 'width' arguments. Its category is flutter, style. It is stable since Dart 2.16.
